items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Wettling and I had taken John Hammond to some flat on South Parkway... George Wettling and I had taken John Hammond up to this flat to hear Meade Lux play.

ctx.x: You weren't in orchestra, you were playing an act were you?
I'd sit in to play the act. George Wettling was the drummer with the band.
